attempts.raw_response: We must adapt to these shifts and ensure that children continue to receive quality education in whatever form that takes. Flexi-schooling offers a bridge between traditional classroom teaching and home-based learning, giving families greater flexibility while maintaining a connection to school life. If the pilot proves successful, the model could be expanded to accommodate more pupils in the future. Parents interested in the scheme are encouraged to submit their applications early, as places will be limited initially. The school has pledged to work closely with families throughout the process to ensure that every child's individual needs are met effectively.

pair.human_continuation: "We are beginning to rethink commuting versus working at home; family time; questioning our lifestyles and where we live; working and studying remotely." Flexi-schooling is recognised as full-time education but delivered in a hybrid format at school and at home. Ms Davies added: "Schools should now prepare for change and greater flexibility in learning. "In the past learning was a place and now we are realising learning is activity, and the activity may extend from the school to the home."
